policy: Fallback for the ten rejected project-date candidates, at the maintainer’s direction on 2026-11-10. Application Info.plist timestamps in nine early app archives were overwritten in 2016; their source English.lproj/CustomInfo.plist preserves contemporary localized application metadata and is referenced by Project Builder. Use that original English file consistently, not later translation files. Retain only candidates within existing intervals and the actual version sequence; development suffixes are compared numerically. Dates are proxies, not verified release days. The two rejected versions retain their existing year-only dates.

previous_date_record.note: Bounded by 1.0d2 and 1.0d3 within the same year. No exact day or month is assigned to the variant.
